comparison.objective: Load four labeled tape cartridges into ordered magazine slots; no tang fracture or fragment recovery.
comparison.physical_skill: Barcode reading, reorientation/hand-off, and repeated cartridge insertion. It lacks coaxial mandrel stabilization and controlled hammer impact.
comparison.success_condition: Correct cartridges in slots 1–4, label-out, flush, released for 1 s. No impact-force, retained-insert, damage, or loose-fragment-containment rubric is given.
comparison.reason: Tests semantic ordering and keyed placement, meaningfully different from contact-loaded notch fracture followed by recovery of four millimetre-scale tangs.
